Chapter 1146: 13: One Palm Strike (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1146: Chapter 13: One Palm Strike (Seeking Subscription)

The internal cosmos fused with the Fierce Sun’s origin source, combining two thirteenth-step methods into one.

Lin Yuan once again performed the Physical Body Divine Ability—’World’,

there was no longer any sort of restriction.

No mention of duration.

As long as the origin source was sufficient, it could be maintained indefinitely.

To some extent, Lin Yuan’s Divine Ability ‘World’ was no longer just a mere divine ability.

Instead, it fused “Infinite Void”, ‘Fierce Sun Creation’, and others, forming a brand new method.

“Hiding a Great Saint? A Great Saint not inferior to us?”

The Black Light Great Saint, Dual Origin Great Saint, and Wild Barbarian Great Saint immediately ceased their conflict, turning their focus on Lin Yuan.

Among them, while engaging each other, they were also mindful of their surroundings, having reached such a level in cultivation, they naturally didn’t want to let other ‘bystanders’ benefit.

Rumble.

The Dual Origin Great Saint acted first, spreading azure-gray power, forcibly penetrating the cosmos coverage of Lin Yuan’s external cosmos, disrupting space-time.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan had already torn open a space-time passage leading to the interior of the Xuanhuang Universe, one foot was already inside, but he then withdrew.

The Black Light Great Saint was unwilling to risk forcing his way through as it could result in his being the last to enter the Xuanhuang Universe, Lin Yuan didn’t want this either.

He held a map of the interior of the Xuanhuang Universe, ensuring that merely being among the first to enter would grant rewards far surpassing those of other Great Saints.

“You capitalized on our fight to take advantage, quite a clever scheme indeed.”

The Black Light Great Saint also activated the Black Light Domain, previously coalesced ninety-nine percent of its power on the Dual Origin Great Saint, Wild Barbarian Great Saint, allowing Lin Yuan to easily repel it with his external cosmos.

Now the Black Light Great Saint collected himself, the Black Light Domain returned full force, continuously colliding with Lin Yuan’s external cosmos, the edges of the space-time turning to dust.

“Your powers are indeed formidable, I dare not claim to be your opponent.” Lin Yuan turned and smiled to the three Great Saints: “That is why I acted thusly, I hope for your understanding.”

“Not an opponent?” The Wild Barbarian Great Saint’s eyes briefly shimmered with murderous intent, besides anything else, Lin Yuan effortlessly bypassing the regions occupied by them and reaching the spot closest to the Xuanhuang Universe demonstrated his strength was no less than theirs.

Not an opponent?

If the Dual Origin Great Saint hadn’t reacted in time, Lin Yuan might indeed have been the first to slip into the Xuanhuang Universe.

Even so, Lin Yuan’s ability to withstand the Dual Origin Great Saint’s azure-gray power, and the Black Light Great Saint’s Black Light Domain, undeniably showcased his strength.

How was he possibly not a match for them?

“Just who are you?”

“Why haven’t I heard of you?”

The Dual Origin Great Saint squinted slightly.

From Lin Yuan’s outburst until now, though brief, they’ve clashed countless times.

But what perplexed the Dual Origin Great Saint was the unfamiliarity with Lin Yuan?

Within the realm of Chaos Venerables, due to vast distances between their respective Void Domains, not knowing each other might occur.

But a Chaos Great Saint? The emergence of a Chaos Great Saint would swiftly send their name across the Chaos Void, many Venerables from the various Void Domains would know.

Take the Nine Phoenix Great Saint and Shadow Demon Great Saint, although newly ascended Great Saints, the Dual Origin Great Saint had heard of them long ago.

Besides, Lin Yuan’s prowess outmatched that of new Great Saints like the Shadow Demon Great Saint, Nine Phoenix Great Saint, not inferior to them in the slightest, such a formidable Great Saint, their fame, and power trajectory should have already spread throughout the Chaos Void?

“A tenth Great Saint?”

“Another hidden Great Saint?”

“Who is this Great Saint who dared to mingle in the Dual Origin Great Saint’s strife yet showed no signs of falling behind?”

The Chaos Venerables watching from afar felt alarmed, the encounters among the four Great Saints, with any random aftermath capable of severely injuring or annihilating a multitude of Venerables.

“The Dual Origin Great Saint and the Black Light Great Saint, each renowned far and wide, how has this newly appeared Great Saint never been seen before?”

“Could it be a Great Saint from the endlessly ancient times?”

Among many Chaos Venerables, speculation arose, the fame of a Great Saint transcends space, yet is gradually forgotten over the long epochs.

Even the most peerless Great Saints, if disappearing for too lengthy a time, ten thousand Cosmic Eras? A million Cosmic Eras? Ten million Cosmic Eras? They will similarly be forgotten, the trace of existence gradually eroding.

For instance, the former Xuanhuang, toppling all challengers in their era, other peerless Great Saints avoided their sharpness, now few know of Xuanhuang, largely limited to special beings like the Eye of Myriad Laws and Altar Spirit.

“A Great Saint from endless ages ago? It appears this Postnatal Universe is quite extraordinary, to attract such a formidable being.”

Those Chaos Venerables watched remotely as the Postnatal Universe’s visible corner emerged, beings at the level of Chaos Great Saints possessing infinite lifespans and finding it difficult to die unless self-destructing.

Yet most Chaos Great Saints ultimately choose to pursue the thirteenth step, as living too long bears little significance to a Great Saint, only by becoming thirteenth-step can one attain ultimate freedom.

“The chaos evolution prowess of the Dual Origin Great Saint can undermine space-time foundations, yet this newly emerged Great Saint manages to withstand such destructive power…..so strong.”

“Not just the Dual Origin Great Saint, the Black Light Great Saint’s Black Light Domain also oppresses the opponent, facing both the Black Light Great Saint and the Dual Origin Great Saint together, while still sustaining no signs of decline…this….”

The Tian Lu Great Saint and several others similarly observed covertly.

They had long discarded any thoughts of entering the Xuanhuang Universe ahead, Dual Origin Great Saint and the others were no easy adversaries, yet Lin Yuan’s forceful intervention and displayed power truly startled them.
